cases.task: Correct one known misspelled word in README.md. The location is known, behavior is unaffected, and the edit is reversible.
Read one known configuration file and explain why its timeout is 30 seconds. Do not modify files, produce an implementation plan, or inspect unrelated parts of the repository.
Fix a clearly localized low-risk bug in one source file and update its existing focused test. The behavior and expected result are fully specified and the change is reversible.
Implement a clearly specified API endpoint across handler, service, and tests in four files. It changes external behavior but involves no security, data migration, or irreversible action.
Analyze the repository-wide architecture and give evidence-backed performance recommendations only. Do not modify files, create a durable implementation plan, or perform a migration.
Redesign and implement the architecture across several subsystems. Compatibility requirements are materially ambiguous, rollout needs multiple stages, and the work will take several hours.
Design and implement a multi-hour migration of production authentication-token storage. Requirements are materially ambiguous and a wrong rollout could invalidate sessions or lose data.
Prepare a large unfamiliar existing repository for Codex use, discover its build and test conventions, and propose repository guidance without overwriting its existing AI instructions.
Independently audit a completed substantial release against the original master request, frozen criteria, actual diff, and verification receipt before it is declared complete.
The same scope-creep failure occurred in three separate releases. Analyze the incidents and propose the lowest reliable prevention layer rather than adding generic prose.
